title: 神鼻子搜救犬Sgiath与火星取土MMX
pdf: https://lcb0378.github.io/michael-english-podcast/vol04/Vol04_晚读讲义_搜救犬Sgiath与火星取土_v7.pdf
pdfName: Vol04_晚读讲义_搜救犬Sgiath与火星取土_v7.pdf

blocks.en: Welcome back to Michael's Morning Listening! Today we meet a real super-sniffer with the best nose in the business. Then we blast off to Mars, where a brave spacecraft will grab a piece of the moon Phobos. Let's jump in!
blocks.cn: 欢迎回到 Michael 的早听晚读！今天我们要认识一位真正的“超级嗅探员”——它的鼻子是业内最强。然后我们要飞向火星，一艘勇敢的飞船要在那里从火星的月亮 Phobos 上取一块“土”回来。开始吧！
blocks.title: 开场白

blocks.en: Meet Sgiath, a six-year-old black Labrador from the Scottish Highlands. She began as a mountain rescue dog — but today she has a different job.
blocks.cn: 认识一下 Sgiath，一只来自苏格兰高地的六岁黑色拉布拉多犬。它一开始是山地搜救犬——但如今它换了一份不同的工作。
blocks.title: 神鼻子搜救犬 Sgiath

blocks.en: Sgiath is now believed to be the first dog in the world trained to smell a dangerous sea creature — the carpet sea squirt, also known as "sea vomit." This creature came from abroad, from waters near Japan, and has spread across harbours in Britain. It grows like a dark cloud over oyster farms and smothers the native sea life underneath.
blocks.cn: 人们认为，Sgiath 是全世界第一只被训练来嗅出一种危险海洋生物的狗狗——地毯海鞘，也叫“海呕吐物”。这种生物来自海外、来自日本附近的海域，如今已经蔓延到英国各地的港口。它像一片乌云一样覆盖在牡蛎养殖场上，把底下的本土海洋生物闷死。
blocks.title: 神鼻子搜救犬 Sgiath

blocks.en: Finding it early is important, but it is not easy. Scientists must wear thick gloves and use DNA tests to spot it. Sgiath needs only her nose. Her handler, Dr. Texa Sim, says the first time Sgiath tried, she went straight to it — all by herself!
blocks.cn: 早点发现它很重要，但并不容易。科学家必须戴上厚手套、用 DNA 检测才能认出它。而 Sgiath 只需要它的鼻子。它的训练员、海洋生态学家 Texa Sim 博士说，Sgiath 第一次尝试，就直奔目标——全靠它自己！
blocks.title: 神鼻子搜救犬 Sgiath

blocks.en: At low tide, she works with Dr. Sim along the shore. When she finds something, she never barks — she just goes still and stares. Her reward is food — she is a greedy girl!
blocks.cn: 退潮时，它和 Sim 博士一起在岸边工作。找到东西时，它从不叫——只是定住不动、死死盯住。它的奖励是食物——它是个小馋鬼！
blocks.title: 神鼻子搜救犬 Sgiath

blocks.en: All this clever nose work won Sgiath the Animal of the Year award from IFAW, the International Fund for Animal Welfare. She shows us the true value of a great nose — and a great dog!
blocks.cn: 这些聪明的鼻子功，为 Sgiath 赢得了 IFAW（国际爱护动物基金会）的年度动物奖。它让我们看到了一个好鼻子——和一条好狗狗——的真正价值！
blocks.title: 神鼻子搜救犬 Sgiath

blocks.en: Now let's fly to Mars — not the planet, but one of its moons!
blocks.cn: 现在让我们飞向火星——不是火星本身，而是它的一颗月亮！
blocks.title: 火星取土 MMX

blocks.en: Japan has launched a big space mission called MMX, which stands for Martian Moons eXploration. Its goal: bring home a piece of Phobos, the larger of Mars' two moons. Phobos is a lumpy, potato-shaped rock about twenty-two kilometers wide — not a perfect ball at all!
blocks.cn: 日本发射了一项名为 MMX 的大型太空任务，全称是“火星卫星探测”。它的目标：从火星的两颗月亮中较大的一颗——Phobos（火卫一）上带一块“土”回家。Phobos 是一块坑坑洼洼、土豆形状的岩石，约二十二公里宽——根本不是个完美的球！
blocks.title: 火星取土 MMX

blocks.en: Scientists still do not know where Phobos came from. Was it a passing asteroid caught by Mars long ago? Or was it born from the dust of a giant crash on young Mars? The answer has been hiding behind millions of miles — until now.
blocks.cn: 科学家至今不知道 Phobos 从哪儿来。它是路过时被火星抓住的小行星吗？还是年轻的火星被巨大小行星撞击后，飞溅的尘埃变成的？答案一直藏在数百万英里之外——直到现在。
blocks.title: 火星取土 MMX

blocks.en: MMX will spend about three years flying around Phobos. A small robot arm will dig into the surface twice, collecting at least ten grams of dust and rocks — about the weight of a rabbit! The landing must be as gentle as silk, because gravity on Phobos is very weak. One wrong move, and the spacecraft could bounce right off!
blocks.cn: MMX 将在 Phobos 周围飞行约三年。一只小小的机械臂会两次钻入地表，收集至少十克尘埃和岩石——大概和一只兔子一样重！着陆必须像丝绸一样轻柔，因为 Phobos 上的引力非常非常弱。稍有不慎，飞船就会被弹飞！
blocks.title: 火星取土 MMX

blocks.en: Then a small capsule will house the precious samples for the long trip home. Count the years: it is a five-year journey! Back on Earth, the whole team will be wide awake for an exciting activity — opening the capsule and reading the story in the dust. Those tiny grains may tell us how Mars' moons were born, and how water and life's building blocks traveled around the young solar system.
blocks.cn: 然后一个小小的返回舱会装着珍贵的样品，踏上漫长的回家路。数数年头：这是一趟五年的旅程！回到地球，整个团队都会睁大眼睛迎接激动人心的时刻——打开返回舱，读一读尘埃里写着的故事。那些微小的颗粒可能会告诉我们：火星的月亮是怎么诞生的，水和构成生命的基本物质，又是怎样在年轻的太阳系里旅行的。
blocks.title: 火星取土 MMX

blocks.en: Here's today's idiom: "have a nose for something." It means you are good at finding or understanding something — like a dog with a great nose!
blocks.cn: 今日俚语：“have a nose for something”。意思是你特别擅长发现或理解某件事——就像一只鼻子超灵的狗狗！
blocks.title: 今日俚语

blocks.en: For example: "My friend Jack has a nose for good stories — he taught himself to write news at twelve." Jack finds stories the way Sgiath finds sea creatures!
blocks.cn: 比如：“我朋友 Jack 对好故事特别敏感——他十二岁就自学写新闻。”Jack 找故事，就像 Sgiath 找海洋生物一样在行！
blocks.title: 今日俚语

blocks.en: So — do you have a nose for something? Maybe you have a nose for music, or a nose for finding lost socks at home!
blocks.cn: 那么——你 have a nose for 什么？也许你对音乐特别敏感，或者特别擅长在家里找到丢了的袜子！
blocks.title: 今日俚语

blocks.en: That brings us to the end of today's show! Here's a question: If you could train a dog to smell out one thing in the world, what would you choose? A lost toy? Hidden treasure? Or maybe your homework?
blocks.cn: 今天的节目就到这里！留一个问题：如果你能训练一只狗狗，让它帮你闻出世界上任何一样东西，你会选什么？是丢了的玩具、藏起来的宝藏，还是你的作业本？
blocks.title: 结束语与互动问题

blocks.en: Have a wonderful day, and see you tomorrow morning!
blocks.cn: 祝你有美好的一天，明天早上见！
blocks.title: 告别

过去分词短语作后置定语
（序数词）后面常接不定式或过去分词短语，这个用法在英语里非常常见。
，点出这种危险生物到底是谁；
是过去分词短语作补充说明，告诉你它的外号。
身份认定（被认为是第一只）→ 限定条件（受过嗅探训练）→ 任务（找出危险生物）→ 点名（地毯海鞘）→ 外号（"海呕吐物"）
。一句话把新闻主角介绍得清清楚楚，是新闻英语"介绍主角"的万能句型。
（练的就是上面拆解的三个知识点）
A. 被动句型：用 is / are believed to be 改写
People believe Sgiath is the best sniffer dog in Britain.
→ Sgiath ____________________ the best sniffer dog in Britain.
People believe the two moons of Mars are pieces of a broken planet.
→ The two moons of Mars ____________________ pieces of a broken planet.
B. 过去分词后置定语：用括号里的短语补全
Sgiath is the first dog in the world ____________________ a dangerous sea creature. (trained to smell)
The capsule is the first box ____________________ pieces of a moon back to Earth. (built to carry)
Phobos, ____________________, is about twenty-two kilometers wide.（火星两颗卫星中较大的那颗）
The carpet sea squirt, also known as "____________________", came from abroad.
